configuration.background_force_rule: unchanged parent force: minus native vertical viscous stencil of prescribed UL=(waves-alpha)*Sref*exp(2kz)+uoffset, with ORIGINAL background gradient boundary fluxes

native_identity: Q_t = A0 + C_3D + W + D + F; C_3D = curl_y[A(full velocity) − A(transverse mean)]
moment_cadence_description: legacy map-cadence moments; temporal closure qualified separately

jet_budget.meaning: Signed work on modes 2–8 of actual Eulerian current minus the fixed maintained background. The initial generated jet is retained. Mode 1 (broad shear) is available in the amplitude data but excluded from this band. Direct 3D work is evaluated along the actual trajectory; subtracting it does not construct a realizable 2D flow.

scope: Signed direct native budgets along the realized trajectory. These are distinct from the finite 3D-versus-2D intervention, which also changes subsequent resolved dynamics. A norm alone is not signed destructive work.
regional_budget_note: Interior and active-Stokes regions retain transport through their edges inside the native terms; their advection integrals need not vanish and viscous projections need not be purely negative. The primary interior trim has the same physical width across grids.
